card.name: Words after a number of years or units
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation right after a number with a time or quantity word, such as 'years ago', 'years old', 'times the', or 'increased by'. It also fires on 'speed' in physics word problems.

modes.label: After 'years'
modes.description: The word 'ago' or the comma or article that follows a stated number of years.
modes.example: Five years<< ago>>, a Chinese lawyer bought an old map

modes.label: Number and comparison words
modes.description: Linking words after a number or amount, as in lab thresholds.
modes.example: in > 2 times<< the>> ULN, with alkaline phosphat

modes.label: Physics problem wording
modes.description: The word 'speed' in a travel word problem with distances and rates.
modes.example: a train travels 180km with a uniform<< speed>> 60km/h,next 1
